analysis.narrativeEn:

· Current price ($65.51) vs SMA5/20/50 ($65.37/$66.95/$66.98) — Above SMA5, below SMA20/50, indicating short-term weak trend and mid-term sideways consolidation.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($62.72/$60.16) — Maintaining medium to long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (78.5%) + current price level near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.8→45.6) — Exited oversold, continuing sideways movement in neutral zone, indicating lack of direction.
· MACD histogram trajectory (histogram -0.2154→-0.3152) — Continued weak convergence, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (middle band $66.95) — Bandwidth at 7.30% indicates a period of reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($65.04) — Pivot-based support level.
· Swing resistance ($68.35) — Resistance level in the downtrend from the 52-week high.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (sideways) — No trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.30x) — Decreased reliability of price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Observation until directional confirmation.

analysis.patternNoteEn: The pattern of sideways movement continues, with the 5-day high/low range contained within the 20-day high/low range, indicating no clear trend.

MACD 히스토그램은 약세 수렴을 지속하며 추가 하락 가능성을 시사한다.

MACD histogram continues its weak convergence, suggesting potential for further downside.
Trading volume is significantly subdued at 0.30x the 5-day average, reducing the reliability of current price movements.
